text:
June: Heads-up proposing a quick UX pass on the stacktrace panel: (1) move export CTA from top-right toolbar into the collapsed-stack flyout, (2) make correlation-id pill keyboard-focusable with copy affordance, (3) ensure collapsed frames announce counts for SRs. Thoughts?
Marco: I'm +1 for contextual export (flyout). reduces accidental exports and groups the action with visible frames. But we should keep a global toolbar export for bulk.
Priya: Accessibility: when a frame is collapsed show "Collapsed: 12 frames" as aria-label on the disclosure. Use aria-expanded on the toggle. For the correlation pill: role=button, tabindex=0, aria-describedby="corrid-help" and announce copy success via aria-live polite.
Len: Copy phrasing nits: instead of "Export stack" use "Download stack snapshot (.json)" and for spans: "Export visible spans (.csv)". For corr id toast keep it short: "Correlation ID copied".
June: Short keyboard flow proposal: focus stack list -> press Enter to expand frame -> once a frame is focused: "c" copies corr id, "x" opens export menu. Need conflict review with other shortcuts.
Marco: Agree on keys; gate behind feature flag. Also add focus indicator for the pill: 2px solid focus token + outline offset for a11y. Example CSS: .corr-pill:focus{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:6px;}
Priya: For screen readers, after expanding a collapsed frame announce: "Expanded frame 3 of 12" and ensure the details region gets focus via focus management. Avoid sudden page-level focus jumps.
Len: Analytics: track export_open_source (toolbar|frame), export_format, corrid_copy_click. We'll want percent of exports initiated from flyout vs toolbar.
deploy-bot: ui-build/stacktrace-flyout-v3 staged (build 2347).
June: Can we run a 20% A/B test for flyout export vs toolbar-only for 2 weeks? Product can segment. Priya/Marco, let's document aria attributes in the Figma specs and review after QA.
Marco: I'll add a short accessibility checklist to the PR. Priya: I'll write the SR announcements and aria-live text. Len: I'll finalize copy and the analytics spec.
